name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.cokerDual
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] M) (t : Module.End ℤ_[l] (M →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)), (∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ)) →
cokerLen t = Module.length ℤ_[l] (LinearMap.ker g) := by
intro l _ M _ _ g t h
have ht : t = LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) g := LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun φ => h x φ
obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := UpperTheory.V.Tower.dualKer l M M g
assume: Assume `(∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ))` (h).
show: If t on the character dual of an ℓ-adic module M acts by precomposition with an endomorphism g of M, the cokernel length of t equals the length of the kernel of g.
strategy: Restrict characters to the kernel. This restriction is surjective and its kernel is the image of t, so the cokernel is isomorphic to the dual of the kernel. Duality preserves length.

steps.claim: Write D(A) = Homℤℓ(A,ℚℓ/ℤℓ). The pairing identity (tχ)(y) = χ(gy) for all χ and y gives tχ = χ ∘ g, so t is pullback along g.
steps.snippet: have ht : t = LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) g := LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun φ => h x φ

steps.claim: For K = ker g, pullback along g has image equal to the kernel of restriction D(M) → D(K). The injectivity of ℚℓ/ℤℓ lets every character on a submodule extend to M, so restriction to K is surjective. Write resₖ for this map.
steps.snippet: obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := UpperTheory.V.Tower.dualKer l M M g

steps.claim: Since t is pullback along g, its image in D(M) is exactly ker(resₖ), the characters vanishing on K.
steps.snippet:
have hr : LinearMap.range t
      = LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (LinearMap.ker g).subtype) := by
    rw [ht]; exact h1
steps.typedFact:
LinearMap.range t
      = LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) (LinearMap.ker g).subtype)

steps.claim: Restriction therefore induces isomorphisms D(M)/im(t) ≅ D(M)/ker(resₖ) ≅ D(K). Isomorphisms preserve length and character duality gives length(D(K)) = length(K), hence length(coker t) = length(ker g).
steps.snippet:
rw [← UpperTheory.V.Tower.lenDual l (LinearMap.ker g)]
  exact ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hr).trans
    (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective _ (h2 (LinearMap.ker g)))).length_eq

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
